font_rule.rule: Use IBM Plex Sans for headings and display type. Use Arial for body copy and UI copy.

canvas.rule: Use Canvas Gray for the page floor, White for separated content surfaces, and Grounded Blue for primary text and structure.

corner_radius.default_rule: Use square corners for boxes, cards, panels, containers, images, chart containers, tables, and layout surfaces.
corner_radius.exception_rule: Approved buttons and search fields may use the rounded component treatment from the source component library.
disallowed: pill shapes outside approved button and search components
corner_radius.llm_rule: Assume square corners for layout. Use rounded corners for approved buttons and search fields that match the source component states.

shadows.replacement: Use borders, solid blocks, spacing, and scale.

graphic_assets.usage: Supporting graphic element when content benefits from the matrix grid motif.
rules: Keep subtle and secondary to content.
Do not recolor unless an approved variant is provided.
Do not use as a full-page decorative texture.
Do not treat this as a required hero pattern.

llm_rules: Use IBM Plex Sans for headings and display type.
Use Arial for body copy and UI copy.
Use rounded corners only as a rare small-component exception when explicitly specified.
Use borders, solid blocks, spacing, and scale for hierarchy.
Do not infer a required hero layout from example imagery.
